note: A shaded streamside site near Oxbow Hollow on the Left Branch of Young Womans Creek, a pull-in at the end of a shared dirt driveway about 525 ft long, with camps nearby. Sold for trailers and RVs only, no tents, and a self-contained toilet is required. The booking page gives a 25-ft maximum vehicle length but also an equipment length of 15 ft and a 20-ft spur, on a 35 by 35 ft site with 20 ft of overhead clearance: ask the district before bringing a 23-ft rig. The agency has closed the south end of Left Branch Young Womans Creek Road indefinitely: it is gated and locked at the state forest boundary about a mile north of North Bend, where it crosses private land, and can be reached only from the north, so the booking page's directions from North Bend no longer work. As of November 2026 the site could not be booked for any night before 2 July 2027. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: 025 Oxbow still listed, Drive-In, Trailer Site category only, max vehicle 25 ft (equipment length 15, spur 20: fit doubt flagged), dirt pull-in 525 ft shared; count 1 and max 25 kept with a sites note, pull_through false. flags: STATUS ADDED temporarily_closed. (a) Sproul advisories page, read 2026-11-10: 'Left Branch Young Woman's Creek Road Closure: ... will be closed indefinitely beginning at the intersection of Young Woman's Creek Rd. Located about one mile north of the town of North Bend in Chapman Township, Left Branch Young Woman's Creek Road is gated and locked at the state forest boundary. Visitors can only access the road and state forest acreage in this region from the north. The southern portion of the road rests on private land and public pass through is at the owner's discretion. Currently, the public is not permitted through the private area. The DCNR Bureau of Forestry and local partners are pursuing a resolution'. The district's gate map (elibrary docId 9816350, 'Gate Installation Left Branch Young Woman's Creek Road', dated June 26, 2025) shows two gates on the road: one at the state forest boundary and one about 0.7 mile farther north at Mudlick Run. The site is about 4.9 miles up the road, north of both, so by the advisory it is reachable only from the north; the booking page still directs campers in from North Bend. (b) Booking calendar: 'Not Available' on every night from 2026-11-17 through 2027-07-01 in every window probed (Nov 2026, May 2027, 9-22 June 2027, 23 June-1 July 2027), Available from 2027-07-02 and through late September 2027. No reason is posted on the site page. Rulings 6 and the closure rule both point the same way: closed for now with a dated note, not a drop.

FIT DOUBT (kept, not a drop): the page reads 'Max Vehicle Length: 25' but 'Equipment Length: 15', 'Length of shortest side of spur to the wheelstop: 20', site 35 x 35 ft, Max Num of People 5. Max vehicle length clears 23 ft and the site is listed for trailers (ruling 4), so it stays, with the three figures in the note and the sites note. If the owner reads the 15-ft equipment length or the 20-ft spur as the governing figure, this single-site entry would have no site left and become a drop candidate under the 23-ft minimum.

GIS layer vs booking page: TrailerAccess 'Yes', NumberVehicles 1, 'Sproul State Forest. Motorized camping only, no tents. Self-contained toilets required. Left-Hand Branch, 5.3 miles from LHBYWC sign, turn right onto camp road at Little Greenlick & Twelvemile Road intersections. Sites before camps on right-hand side of road.' Agrees with the booking page's Trailer Site category; the GIS directions also start from the now-closed southern end.

Agency access statements: dirt driveway 525 ft, shared; no grade listed, no Severe grade, no 4WD or wet-weather wording on the site page; clearance 20 ft. This page does not carry the 'remote dirt or gravel roads' caution that the neighbouring sites do.

WATERFRONT (lead only, not written): the page says 'Streamside campsite along Left Branch of Young Womans Creek near Oxbow Hollow' and 'Distance to Lake/Stream: Less than 300 feet'; NHD puts the Left Branch flowline 6 m from the pin (a second reach 22 m). Leaf-off imagery shows a small clearing at the pin surrounded by woods; the stream channel is not resolvable under the trees, so open ground to the water is unconfirmed. Stays not waterfront; the strongest lead in the batch.
Pin: stored pin = booking point = GIS point (1 m), on the clearing. Not moved.

ATV check (ruling 1): the DCNR Sproul roadside-campsites map (05/02/2025) draws the numbered and CR-series sites as ordinary roadside campsites and shows the 'Whiskey Springs ATV Area Campsites' (WS series) as a separate inset; this site is not one of them and no agency page places it in an ATV parking lot. The Sproul advisories page does warn 'Stay Alert for ATVs on Roads' (the Northcentral Regional ATV Trail uses some forest roads). Kept.

Agency pages disagree on the district's own inventory: the Sproul camping page says 'Sproul State Forest offers nine roadside campsites for overnight camping in RVs. No tent camping permitted. Self-contained toilets are required.' while the district's 2025 map labels CR001-CR021 plus the WS series, and the CR booking pages list 'Tent Site, Trailer Site'. Nothing here depends on it.
